public_rationale: There is evidence that execution and power problems increased risk premiums on AI project loans. That does not settle the much broader claim about widespread failed delivery and effectively all related debt. The available market summary shows different behavior across debt segments, while earlier construction research records substantial capacity additions. Neither source establishes or disproves the full claim for the stated episode.
limitations: The most relevant delay-to-pricing evidence is a secondary summary.
Earlier construction growth is context, not a decisive counterexample.
No consistent sector-wide attribution separates delays from other pricing forces.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: AI data centers are simply not getting built, because the power isn't there or construction is taking longer than expected, and this is putting pressure on effectively any data center-related debt.

statement.excerpt: The other problem is, as I discussed last week, that these things are simply not getting built, either because the power isn’t there or construction is taking longer than expected, which is in turn putting pressure on effectively any data center-related debt

from_speaker: these things are simply not getting built
construction is taking longer than expected
putting pressure on effectively any data center-related debt
our_interpretation: Read not getting built as widespread failures to deliver usable facilities on schedule, rather than literally no construction or completions anywhere.
Effectively any means pressure across nearly the whole relevant debt market, not merely selected troubled projects.
Pressure means lower debt prices or wider borrowing spreads attributable to construction or power delays.
The surrounding reference to a selloff over the last two months supplies a July 29 through September 29, 2026 assessment window.
Effectively any is a scope claim, not a conditional antecedent.
criteria.support_condition: Representative project records establish widespread power or construction delays, and broad debt-market evidence links those delays to adverse repricing across nearly all relevant segments.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative evidence establishes that the asserted delivery failure or nearly market-wide causal pressure did not hold. Isolated completions or isolated unaffected securities are insufficient by themselves.
